answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, so a Sybil attacker must pay real collateral for each fake identity instead of spawning a free spiral of sock puppets. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and the loss is recorded on a public sable-dark attestation trail, like pigment staining every transaction it touched, so the attacker cannot quietly reuse the same reputation and must pay again for each new fake.
